name: HomeCraft Device Control
role: HomeCraft is the protocol hub; hardware advertises capabilities and implements its own adapter.
compatibility: Existing page IDs0..12 preserved; usage13 and weather require advertised capabilities. Missing capabilities are never fabricated.

optional_controls.rotation_control: 0 when the display has no rotate operation; absent on legacy firmware, which supports it with device_control:1
optional_controls.environment_history: 0 when the display keeps no temperature/humidity history; absent on legacy firmware, which supports it
optional_controls.rule: HomeCraft hides or disables a declined control and never polls or reports it as pending

harness_aggregate.packet: Existing profile 4 / DeepSeek Harness packet, without o; d/wt/mt/u contain the hub's deduplicated usage, never one Mac's independent consumption.
harness_aggregate.rule: Replace legacy per-Mac totals with this authoritative snapshot. Never add machine observations to it or export it through op:harness as a machine source. Unavailable aggregates are withdrawn as s:0 without numeric fields (the App retains the original error); missing periods remain unknown across calendar changes. Per-Mac-only displays do not receive Harness usage from new clients.

weather.capability: weather:1 (one city) or weather:2 (two cities); forecast:1 adds tomorrow

request.slot: optional 0 or 1; omitted means 0; slot 1 only for weather:2 displays
request.tomorrow: optional [WMO_code, low_tenths, high_tenths]; only for displays advertising forecast:1

weather.expiry: HomeCraft sends a summary at most 6h old and sends clear_request when weather is off, a city is removed or a summary expired; cities are user-chosen (at most two, default Singapore), never IP or coordinates.

request.q: 0 重要紧急 | 1 重要不紧急 | 2 紧急不重要 | 3 不紧急不重要
items: UTF-8 <=48 bytes each, at most 5 open items
request.n: optional: open items in this quadrant (>= items sent, <= 999)

todo.rule: One message per quadrant; an empty items array clears it. HomeCraft owns the list; done items are never sent.

request.title: UTF-8 <=36 bytes
request.author: UTF-8 <=24 bytes, e.g. 唐 · 王之涣
lines: UTF-8 <=60 bytes each: two verses such as 白日依山尽，黄河入海流。

poem.rule: HomeCraft chooses one bundled public-domain poem per UTC+8 day (or the user's next pick) and sends it once per connection and on change.

request.mt: [first day of that month, tokens or -1]

totals.rule: The today/week/month totals exactly as HomeCraft's home page shows them (every verified Codex account, effective Harness, OK readings only); -1 is unknown, never 0. Sent once per connection and on change. A display shows these for matching periods instead of adding its per-provider packets, which carry one Codex account.

rows: at most 2, in the order of HomeCraft's Climate page

rows.name: UTF-8 <=48 bytes, the place name the user gave the display (else its default name)
rows.here: true for the receiving display itself: it shows its own sensor

rows.name: UTF-8 <=48 bytes
rows.at: sample time; t/h/at together or all absent (no reading yet)

places.rule: Places the user named on the Climate page, else every display HomeCraft knows. Readings are HomeCraft's latest from each display, never estimated; a place without one is sent by name only and shown as unknown. Sent once per connection and on change; an empty rows array returns the display to its own indoor reading.

status_fields.device.power: [usb, battery_present, charging, percent]; percent -1 when not calibrated; usb/charging 0 when the display cannot read its charger
status_fields.device.mv: optional battery millivolts measured by the display

battery.rule: A display may show coarse voltage-based bars; HomeCraft never presents millivolts as a calibrated percentage.
